page_title: Rephrase AI | Free AI Rephraser for Better Writing

summary.name: Rephrase AI
summary.one_liner: Rephrase AI is a web-based AI writing tool that paraphrases and rewrites sentences, paragraphs, emails, and full drafts while keeping the original meaning.
use_cases: Making a dense academic or technical paragraph easier to follow
Rewording a work email to a more formal tone
Shortening a long explanation into a concise version
Making AI-generated drafts sound more natural
Finding a better word or sentence when stuck
summary.what_it_does: The page describes an editor where you paste a sentence or paragraph from a draft and get a rephrased version. You start from a writing profile and adjust formality, complexity, brevity, and creativity sliders. Pro users can enable SuperRephrase Mode for a deeper refinement pass. The site also offers several free single-purpose tools for full drafts, sentences, paragraphs, and single words, plus a free AI humanizer. The page recommends reviewing the output against the original before using it.
notable: Adjustable formality, complexity, brevity, and creativity controls
Searchable history of earlier versions (per testimonial)
Separate free tools for sentences, paragraphs, words, and full drafts
caveats: Free plan is limited to 3 standard rephrases per month and 3,000 characters per rephrase
Pro plan is $29 per month for unlimited rephrases and up to 10,000 characters per rephrase
SuperRephrase Mode is listed as a Pro feature in the pricing section, though the free plan also lists it
